name: Zurich Instruments
description: Zurich Instruments is a Swiss manufacturer of quantum computing control systems, lock-in amplifiers, and arbitrary waveform generators. Spun out of ETH Zurich and acquired by Rohde & Schwarz in 2021, the company provides the hardware layer between software and physical qubits, with its ZQCS platform designed for large-scale quantum computer operation.
